description: This file contains an implementation of a NEON-optimized quantized matrix multiplication kernel used in PyTorch's QNNPACK backend, specifically for 6x4 block processing on ARM NEON architecture.

methods.name: pytorch_q8gemm_ukernel_6x4__neon
methods.description: Performs a NEON-optimized quantized matrix multiplication kernel for 6x4 blocks, handling zero points, requantization, and output clamping.
